atomicity.reason: One obligation: the published permitted discharge power follows one linear ramp between 55 °C and 60 °C.

comprehensibility.reason: Self-contained: endpoints, shape, input (highest valid cell temperature), output and purpose are stated, and 'full permitted value' reads as the unreduced permitted power.

feasibility.reason: A linear interpolation on temperature is trivial, and its zero-power end at 60 °C lines up with REQ_CELL_OVERTEMPERATURE opening the contactors above 60 °C, so nothing contradicts it.

parent_fit.reason: Implements the parent's observable: near the upper temperature limit the allowed drive power falls off gradually and predictably instead of cutting out at a single threshold.

unambiguity.reason: The ramp itself is unambiguous, but it states the published power unconditionally while REQ_THERMAL_ACTUATOR_FAILSAFE states a different published value for the same output under overlapping conditions (e.g. 56 °C with an unconfirmed request: ramp 80 %, fallback 30 %); only the architecture resolves this by taking the minimum.
unambiguity.suggestion: State the precedence in the requirement, e.g. the published permitted discharge power is the lower of the derating value and any active fallback limit.

verifiability.reason: Concrete: sweep the highest valid cell temperature and check the published power against the stated ramp (full at 55 °C, half at 57.5 °C, zero at 60 °C); endpoints, shape and unit are specified.

summary: Clear, testable derating ramp consistent with the 60 °C overtemperature limit; unambiguity reduced because precedence against the fallback limit is stated only in the architecture.
